issues: The trace was a 2px dark line trapped in a small card on a light grey stage, with no oscilloscope glow
The spike was an envelope multiplied onto the wave, so it read as slightly larger waves rather than a burst event
The live readout was 50px with ~17px ticks, and it jittered every frame, so neither value nor event was readable
After the brake the screen went completely dead with no final focus
changes: Midnight look: a full-bleed 1728×520 scope screen with graticule, centre tick cross and left fade-out; an electric-blue phosphor trace with core line, two glow layers and a bright newest 280px
The spike is now a Gaussian pulse with precursor and aftershock (~2.2× normal amplitude) that turns coral and thicker, then gets a pinned 'BURST 2,453 req/s' tag with a drop line that flows left
Layout: fictional product Sonde kicker with a LIVE light, a 176px main readout sampled every 3 frames, and 84px p99 / error-rate readouts that all jump and change colour with the spike
The write head sits at 86% with a vertical scan line, a bloom and a horizontal value guide; the bloom turns coral during the spike
165f timeline: streaming from frame 0, spike at 46–68f, out-cubic brake at 104–118f (LIVE becomes PAUSED), then a 47f hold with a 2.5% push toward the spike
